items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Emmanuel and I made a brass band up together, the Armwood Brass Band.

ctx.x: Yeah, we played in the orchestra on the Parisian roof garden, with Emmanuel Perez's band. And then after we left there, why, uh, uh, Emmanuel and I made a brass band up together, the Armwood Brass Band.
